responses.N1:
---

## Project
**NCLEX-PN trainer** — a free/cheap study tool with error journal and remediation coach built around practical nursing scope (reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan).

## Rules (Governing — you must follow these)

**rule – Architecture:** Plain JSON files only, no database. You want to edit this on your phone in a text editor.

**rule – Data boundary (non-negotiable):** Never store actual question text from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, or any paid qbank — not even paraphrased. Topic tags and your own notes only.

**rule – Content framing:** All remediation must be PN-scoped. Always frame around reinforce/monitor/report/follow the care plan. Never approach topics from an RN assessment or initiation angle.

**rule – Features (parked):** No gamification, streaks, or leaderboards for now. Distraction from core learning. Can revisit later.

## Open Obligation (Blocking sharing)

**rule — Before study group launch:** Someone with a nursing background must review every plan template to verify scope-of-practice wording is accurate to PN scope. This must be done before you show it to your study group.

## Pending Proposals (Not governing yet — need your confirmation)

- **rule:** Don't package or put on GitHub. Local only for now.
- **rule:** Add a simple "days studied in a row" counter to the summary line — just that one counter for your own motivation. Everything else stays parked.
- **rule:** Study group review is parked. Improve it locally first; revisit when ready.

---

**Bottom line:** You can't share this until someone checks the scope-of-practice wording. Everything else is local dev. Do rule–rule need confirmation, or are you good with those?
